moves.label: Quick Saiyan Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a tiny active window and guarded recovery.
moves.reason: Short standing punch hits high and returns quickly.

moves.label: Low Saiyan Sweep
moves.description: Slow low kick with a long active sweep and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Low sliding kick attacks across the shin line.

moves.label: Saiyan Body Blow
moves.description: Quick mid body blow with a brief active hit and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Compact forward punch travels through the torso line.

moves.label: Heavy Saiyan Kick
moves.description: Slow mid kick with a long active swing and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Standing kick arc hits through the body line.

moves.label: Saiyan Twin Strike
moves.description: Slow mid two-part strike with a long active follow-through and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Two-hit standing sequence stays at mid height.

moves.label: Rising Saiyan Launcher
moves.description: Fast mid jumping launcher with a modest active lift and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Quick hop into an upward kick carries authored launcher height.

moves.label: Saiyan Tornado Kick
moves.description: Slow mid jumping kick that works as a tornado extender.
moves.reason: Hop-kick route is authored as a tornado and visually rotates through the strike.

moves.label: Low Saiyan Hop Kick
moves.description: Slow low jumping kick with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Low route leaves the ground but has no knockdown or launcher flag.

moves.label: Low Saiyan Knockdown
moves.description: Slow low jumping sweep that knocks down after a long active kick.
moves.reason: Low jump-kick sequence is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Saiyan Tornado Crush
moves.description: Slow mid jumping tornado kick that knocks down on a committed hit.
moves.reason: Airborne spin route carries tornado, jump, and knockdown flags.

moves.label: Crouch Saiyan Rush
moves.description: Fast mid crouch rush with very long active punches and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch route advances through repeated mid strikes.

moves.label: Crouch Saiyan Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid crouch launcher with a tiny active lift and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-rising strike is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Saiyan Jab
moves.description: Fast high overdrive jab with a modest active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive route reuses the high jab family.

moves.label: Galick Aura Drive
moves.description: Instant special knockdown drive with huge active Saiyan energy pressure.
moves.reason: Long aura-backed sequence is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: Overdrive Tornado Kick
moves.description: Slow mid overdrive jump kick that works as a tornado extender.
moves.reason: Overdrive route shares the authored tornado hop-kick family.

moves.label: Sidestep Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Slow low sidestep jump kick with a long active sweep and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep low kick leaves the ground and attacks low.

moves.label: Sidestep Tornado Kick
moves.description: Slow mid sidestep jump kick that works as a tornado extender.
moves.reason: Sidestep route shares the tornado hop-kick animation family.

moves.label: Rising Saiyan Body Blow
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising strike with a modest active window and quick finish.
moves.reason: While-standing command uses the mid body-blow silhouette.

moves.label: Rising Tornado Kick
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising jump kick that works as a tornado extender.
moves.reason: While-standing kick has authored tornado and jump flags.

moves.label: Ducking Saiyan Jab
moves.description: Fast high ducking jab with a modest active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab repeats the high punch frames.

moves.label: Ducking Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Slow low ducking jump kick with a long active sweep and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down kick shares the low jumping kick family.

moves.label: Diagonal Saiyan Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid diagonal launcher with a tiny active lift and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward strike carries authored launcher height.

moves.label: Diagonal Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Slow low diagonal jump kick with a long active sweep and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward kick shares the low jumping kick animation.

moves.label: Forward Saiyan Strike
moves.description: Slow mid forward strike with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command is a compact body-height strike.

moves.label: Forward Saiyan Body Blow
moves.description: Steady mid forward body blow with a modest active window and quick finish.
moves.reason: Forward-heavy route uses the mid body-blow animation.

moves.label: Advancing Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Slow low advancing jump kick with a long active sweep and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward kick uses the low jumping kick family.

moves.label: Saiyan Quick Jab
moves.description: Fast high quarter-circle jab with a modest active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab repeats the high punch frames.

moves.label: Galick Low Hop Kick
moves.description: Steady low jumping kick with long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick is the longer low jump-kick variant.

moves.label: Final Flash Tornado
moves.description: Slow mid jumping tornado kick that knocks down after a tiny active hit.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle route is authored as tornado, jump, and knockdown.
